collate_samples_into_batch: collate a list of sample dicts into a padded batch tensor with source and target tokens sorted by length
create_dummy_dictionary: create a dummy Dictionary with a given vocab size and token prefix for testing purposes
create_dummy_dataloader: create a DataLoader from sample dicts using the collate function with specified padding and eos indices
setup_sequence_generator: setup a test translation task and model with predefined beam probabilities for sequence generation testing
train_language_model: train a language model on a data directory with optional validation and custom flags
